nodes.summary: The list of all copy sites of the 3-COLOR emitter, each exactly once, in the order $o_1, \dots, o_4$, $c_1, \dots, c_4$, $d_1, \dots, d_4$, $r_1, \dots, r_{11}$, $e_1, e_2$, $z_1, z_2, z_3$ and the vertex-count site.
nodes.title: The copy sites of the 3-COLOR emitter, listed

nodes.summary: The bits of an edge $(u, v)$ in the edge-list encoding of a graph: $u$ copies of true, then false, then $v$ copies of true, then false.
nodes.title: Bit encoding of an edge

nodes.summary: For an optional symbol (the top of a stack, absent when the stack is empty), the test is true exactly when the symbol is present and is a literal marker of some polarity; it is false for every other symbol and for an empty stack.
nodes.title: Literal-marker test

nodes.summary: The counter $n$ (the next vertex) is held on stack $N$, the counter $r$ (the OR output) on stack $R$, and the counter $u$ (an earlier literal vertex) on stack $U$.
nodes.title: Stack of a counter

nodes.summary: The emitter has thirteen stacks: $T$ (tokens), $O$ (output), $N$ (the next free vertex), $R$ (the current OR output), $D$ (earlier occurrences), $E$ (the walk's other side), $A$ (the current name), $P$ (its polarity), $F$ (the first-literal flag), $U$ (an earlier literal vertex), and the scratch stacks $X$ and $B$ for comparisons and $W$ for copies.
nodes.title: Stacks of the 3-coloring emitter

nodes.summary: `init`: palette; `cls`: next clause; `lits`: next literal; `lp`, `nm`: pop the polarity and the name; `walk` to `dr`: walk `D` (compare, restore, select the polarity case, move the name and the vertex to `E`, or the vertex to `U` and push the consistency edges); `back`: move `E` back to `D`; `putN` to `putP`: put the occurrence on `D`; `aft`, `fA` to `fC`: set `R` and advance `N`; `clr`: clear `R`; `zN`: advance…
nodes.title: Control labels of the 3-coloring emitter

nodes.summary: A quiescent state records the contents of the token stack $T$ and of the stacks $D$, $E$, $A$, $P$ (lists of token symbols), the content of the output stack $O$ (a list of bits), and four natural numbers $n$, $r$, $f$, $u$: the values of the counters $N$ (next free vertex), $R$ (current OR output), $F$ (first-literal flag) and $U$ (an earlier literal vertex).
nodes.title: Quiescent states of the 3-COLOR emitter

nodes.summary: The label at which the 3-COLOR emitter continues after a copy site. In each of the chains $o_1, \dots, o_4$; $c_1, \dots, c_4$; $d_1, \dots, d_4$; $r_1, \dots, r_{11}$; $e_1, e_2$; $z_1, z_2, z_3$, every site but the last continues with $\mathtt{pre}$ of the next site of its chain. The last sites continue as follows: $o_4$ with $\mathtt{lp}$, $c_4$ and $d_4$ with $\mathtt{dr}$, $r_{11}$ with…
nodes.title: Successor label of a copy site

nodes.summary: For a list of edges $e_1, \dots, e_k$ (pairs of natural numbers), the output is the concatenation $b(e_k) \cdots b(e_1)$, where $b(u, v)$ is $u$ ones, a zero, $v$ ones and a zero.
nodes.title: Bits pushed for a list of edges

nodes.summary: The bits pushed for the edges $(0, 1)$, $(0, 2)$, $(1, 2)$ in this order, that is, for the triangle on the palette vertices $0$, $1$, $2$.
nodes.title: Bits of the palette triangle

nodes.summary: The TM2 program, with the stacks, stack alphabets and labels of the emitter and a Boolean local state, that builds the 3-COLOR instance of a CNF formula from its token stack. It first pushes the palette triangle on the output stack and adds $3$ to the next free vertex $N$. It then reads the clauses one at a time. For each literal occurrence it pushes the occurrence triangle, walks the earlier occurrences comparing…
nodes.title: The 3-COLOR emitter machine

nodes.summary: For every bit string $x$, SAT accepts $x$ if and only if 3-COLOR accepts the image of $x$ under the SAT to 3-COLOR reduction map on bit strings.
nodes.title: Correctness of the SAT to 3-COLOR map on bit strings

nodes.summary: The type of copy sites has 29 distinct elements: $o_1, \dots, o_4$ for the occurrence triangle; $c_1, \dots, c_4$ and $d_1, \dots, d_4$ for the consistency edges with an earlier occurrence of equal and of opposite polarity; $r_1, \dots, r_{11}$ for the OR gadget; $e_1, e_2$ for the clause end; $z_1, z_2, z_3$ for the empty clause; and one site for the vertex count. Equality of sites is decidable.
nodes.title: Copy sites of the 3-COLOR emitter

nodes.summary: In the 3-coloring emitter, the sites $c_2$, $c_4$, $d_2$ and $d_4$ copy the earlier-literal counter $U$, the sites $r_4$, $e_1$ and $e_2$ copy the OR-output counter $R$, and every other site copies the next-vertex counter $N$.
nodes.title: Counter copied by a copy site

nodes.summary: The type with the three elements $n, r, u$, naming the counters of the 3-coloring emitter that a copy site can read: the next free vertex $n$, the current OR output $r$ and an earlier literal vertex $u$.
nodes.title: Counters read by copy sites of the 3-COLOR emitter

nodes.summary: The emitter machine starts at its palette label, the label whose instruction pushes the palette triangle onto the output stack.
nodes.title: Start label of the 3-coloring emitter

nodes.summary: The list of bits a copy site of the 3-coloring emitter pushes onto the output stack below its counter copy, read top-first and written with $1$ for true and $0$ for false: $o_1$: 10, $o_2$: 0, $o_3$: 0110, $o_4$: 10110; $c_1$: 10, $c_2$: 0, $c_3$: 0, $c_4$: 10; $d_1$: 0, $d_2$: 0, $d_3$: 10, $d_4$: 10; $r_1$: 110, $r_2$: 0, $r_3$: 1110, $r_4$: 0, $r_5$: 1110, $r_6$: 110, $r_7$: 11110, $r_8$: 110, $r_9$: 11110,…
nodes.title: Constant block of a copy site

nodes.summary: The partial reading of token symbols as unary units used by the 3-coloring emitter: the clause-end symbol is read as the bit true, and every other symbol has no reading, so it ends a run of units.
nodes.title: Reading unary units

nodes.summary: For each of the three counters read by copy sites of the 3-coloring emitter, the unit symbol in the alphabet of the counter's stack is the clause-end token symbol.
nodes.title: Unit symbol of a counter

nodes.summary: The output stack has the booleans (bits) as its alphabet; every other stack has the token symbols as its alphabet.
nodes.title: Stack alphabets of the 3-coloring emitter

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
